defeats.how: Jaketch gunned down Reed and Ben, then used his body-heat visor to hit the invisible Sue; the weapon was a metabolic booster.
defeats.evidence: Sue meets the same fate as her colleagues

defeats.how: The synopsis only says a Terran spaceship destroyed all the Skrull forces sent in pursuit.
defeats.evidence: a Terran spaceship has destroyed all the Skrull forces that were sent in pursuit

defeats.how: Not realising the Skrull ship carried the FF, Nova's ship answered Reed's impersonation of a Skrull officer by apparently blowing the ship apart.
defeats.evidence: Nova’s ship responds by apparently blowing the Skrull ship apart
